purpose: Original measured processing costs only; no quality grades or new inference; raw execution records remain local.

boundaries.native: direct worker processing to native result and faithful export ready; includes required native processing/render/export, excludes service semantic conversion and API assembly
boundaries.service: saved deterministic postprocessing wall time only; native JSON loading and final persistence/scoring/reporting timed separately
boundaries.prohibited_sum: historical native duration plus saved service replay time is not a newly measured end-to-end duration
boundaries.rounds: totals of original case processing durations; not whole-job start-to-finish wall time
boundaries.repetitions: perf80 repetitions are not independent documents

missing_policy: null/unavailable remain unknown, never zero or estimated; observed subtotals are not complete totals

tts_shared_observation.limitation: start/end health and persistent-job counters are not atomic admission control; short calls without a persistent job may be unobserved
